title: VIPA Controls WinPLC7
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW STACK-BASED BUFFER OVERFLOW CWE-121 A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability has been identified, where an attacker with a specially crafted packet could overflow the fixed length buffer. This could allow remote code execution. CVE-2017-5177 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.5 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ). RESEARCHER Ariele Caltabiano (kimiya) working with Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative reported this vulnerability. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Commercial Facilities, Critical Manufacturing Countries/Areas Deployed: Africa, Americas, Asia, Australia, Europe, Middle East Company Headquarters Location: Herzogenaurach, Germany This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
